prompts.name: event_build
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached illustration-only crop from version 2 of event_build. ONLY requested change: enlarge and freshly re-render the existing complete subject group including its grass and little white daisies, to match the large subject occupancy of original game event cards. Preserve exact subject identity, arrangement, viewing angle, colors, cream radial sunlight background, lighting, soft polished 3D toy rendering and material style. Subject is the SAME cream single house with red roof and blue windows, small green upward arrow above right, ONE small hammer lower right. No new objects, no removed objects. The image is ONLY the rectangular illustration, no card border, header or bottom text strip. Landscape aspect ratio exactly 321:265. Keep the complete group centered, bottom grass at 96% canvas height, topmost existing object at 9% to 12% canvas height; complete grass/subject footprint across 88% to 92% canvas width leaving 4% to 6% blank cream ray margins at each side. Make the principal house/train/clover/cloud/flag conspicuously LARGER than the reference, with the principal object taking about 75% to 85% of illustration height including existing upper accessory when present. Arrow and hammer remain small secondary accessories in the SAME relative positions. Sharp high-resolution fresh rendering; no blur, no crude pixel enlargement, no painted outline, no extra sparkles. Keep all shapes comfortably inside frame, not clipped. Original pale ivory/butter radial rays remain behind all objects; do not add a frame, gold top arcs, a title ribbon, lower description band or text. No letters or numbers whatsoever. Deliver one enlarged illustration only at high resolution.
